plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Perle IDS industrial Ethernet switch. It reports uptime, average CPU utilization, free memory, temperature sensors with status, power supply status, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 1966). Fan status is not collected.
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: Average CPU utilization of the Perle IDS switch in percent (PERLE-SYSINFO-MIB perleAverageCPUUtilization DisplayString scalar, numeric value parsed at collection).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free memory of the Perle IDS switch in bytes (PERLE-SYSINFO-MIB perleMemory DisplayString scalar in KB, parsed and scaled to bytes at collection). The MIB has no total memory object, so utilization is not derived.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Reading of each temperature sensor of the Perle IDS switch in degrees Celsius (PERLE-ENVMON-MIB perleEnvMonTemperatureStatusValue). Sensors reported as notPresent are skipped.

metrics.name: device_temperature_state
metrics.description: State of each temperature sensor of the Perle IDS switch (PERLE-ENVMON-MIB perleEnvMonTemperatureState), normalised so that normal(1) = 1 and warning/critical/shutdown/notFunctioning = 2; notPresent sensors are skipped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: State of each power supply of the Perle IDS switch (PERLE-ENVMON-MIB perleEnvMonPowerSupplyState), normalised so that normal(1) = 1 and warning/critical/shutdown/notFunctioning = 2; empty (notPresent) power supply positions are skipped.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
